verdict: No live API condition (generic, generic_v9) is monolithic: each run makes at least 4 model calls (full, audit, reconcile_full, report), sends the schema digest (schema_digest.digest_text) rather than the LinkML schema, and may add follow-up turns (full_readdress, readdress, repair, report_regate).

The monolithic shape (prompt + full LinkML schema + concatenated documents, one call) survives only in legacy scripts: src/download/process_concatenated_d4d.py, src/download/process_concatenated_d4d_claude.py.
Live conditions with an agentic component or agentic-only instruction: generic, generic_v9.

exceptions.reason: The `bridge2ai` profile is the designated home of the study's vocabulary pin, comparison-arm project lists, healthsheet input and transcript aliases; `neutral` carries none, and a profile is never inferred from a project name.
The study manifest is the project registry: naming, scope and source ranking are data here and reach the model only for the study's own bundles.
